# run
# expect X-Tag: 1
# expect X-Tag: 2
# note RFC 9110, 5.3 gives meaning to the order of field lines sharing a name
>>> f.rr
-- sends repeated header fields --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
X-Tag: 1
X-Tag: 2

>>> want f.rr
-- sends repeated header fields --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
X-Tag: 1
X-Tag: 2

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 2
Content-Type: text/plain

ok
